verdict.rationale: Instinct connects to some external services: users can link Google Workspace (Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Docs, etc.) and disconnect it in Workspace settings, and can store third-party credentials in the Vault so the agent signs in on their behalf. However, nothing shows a browsable directory or marketplace of apps and connectors, and the vendor's public surface is just the homepage. One user also found that hooking up GitHub and Obsidian stalled on credential handling. Missing for 10: a browsable connector/app directory, a documented catalog of supported third-party integrations, a one-click add flow beyond Google Workspace, and hands-on corroboration of adding non-Google connectors.
